sloka: सा ऽहमेवं गते काले मर्तुमिच्छामि सर्वथा ।न च मे विहितो मृत्युरस्मिन् दुःखे ऽपि वर्तति ।। ५.२६.४८।।।।
transliteration: sā 'hamevaṁ gate kāle martumicchāmi sarvathā ।na ca me vihito mṛtyurasmin duḥkhe 'pi vartati ।। 5.26.48।।।।

translations.english: "By all means I wish to die in these circumstances. However, death is not ordained for me even in this sorrowful state.
